name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching-Set Size / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{RTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Lift any subfamily of any coordinate projection by choosing one preimage for each trace. Its minimum teaching-set size is no greater than the lifted class's minimum projected teaching-set size; maximize over the projection and subfamily.
